_read_me: Sign-in configuration for this deployment. Every value is null out of the box, which is the honest default: a static copy of these pages verifies nobody, so with nothing configured the sign-in dialog offers only a device passkey and a wallet signature. Fill in the values your host actually operates and nothing else — WebXR/shared/auth.js never contacts an endpoint that is null here. See docs/sign-in.md. mapboxToken is read by WebXR/shared/mapbox.js (the Bay Atlas and Bay World's satellite ground) and must be a Mapbox *public* token or null; with null nothing is ever requested from Mapbox. See docs/mapbox.md.
